$Comment: One Records tab per run of a calendar event: it fills while the run is live and still reads after the run ends. Event is the event's id, or * for every event that is live. Keep is how many runs of each event the board holds, the newest first. A server owner can follow one event only in mods/ziggfreedcommon/stats.json, as "Season": { "Event": "Hallows_Eve" }.
